journeysRow.description: A numeric conversion requires nonnull reachedSessions and positive eligibleSessions; runtime also verifies conversion = reachedSessions / eligibleSessions and reachedSessions <= eligibleSessions.

accountsRow.description: Unmeasured/not_configured counts must all be null. When both attribution counts are known, count must be known and equal their sum. Any known part cannot exceed a known total. One unknown part may remain null; runtime verifies arithmetic without inventing it.
